title: Misremembered web_fetch calls?!
body: I will just cross-post this here (from https://github.com/blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX/issues/16) since the issue might as well sit inside OpenFox. I'm using your vLLM recipe and altough I suspect this has nothing to do with your contributions, I'm kind of at a loss where to look for testers. The thing is: ALL my web_fetch requests seem to somehow be rewritten inside the LLM itself! I took a pcap on the harness machine: the LLM does indeed return a web_fetch command with the correct URL and it's indeed correctly fetched by the harness' host. The target host also sees a connection coming from the correct source IP and there's also no scraping activity on the server afterwards - at least not yet. BUT: whenever I ask the LLM to look up the URL it just requested, I always get a chinese Alibaba cloud URL back: From the pcap I can tell that it's also not the harness somehow injecting the URL back into the LLM, since the first mention of aliyuncs.com in the pcap is the one after my "which URL did you fetch?" request. Does this happen to anyone else and can I get a sane explanation for this behaviour which is different from "those chinese models are spying on us"?!
